summary: Fairfax Financial Holdings completed a sale of 67,618,981 common shares of Poseidon Corp. at US$28.30 per share for aggregate proceeds of ~US$1.91B and a pre-tax realized gain of ~US$837M, representing 23.1% of Poseidon's outstanding shares. Following the sale, Fairfax retains 22.2% ownership and continues to account for the remaining investment under the equity method. The filing is a Form 6-K news release announcing completion of a previously announced sale, with no board recommendation or advisor named. The transaction reduces Fairfax's stake but maintains significant influence. Watch for any further monetization of the remaining stake and impact on Fairfax's investment portfolio.
